```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(extrafont)
library(cowplot)
library(car)
library(lme4)
library(effectsize)
```
```{r}
# function to define the B3 lab theme
theme_B3 <- function () { 
  theme_classic() +
    theme(
      panel.grid.major  = element_blank(),  # remove major gridlines
      panel.grid.minor  = element_blank(),  # remove minor gridlines
      plot.subtitle = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold"), # center & bold
      plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold") # center & bold 
    )
}
```
```{r figure out working directory}
getwd()
```
```{r}
key <- read.csv("/Users/AprilBooth/Desktop/Dissertation/keys/chick_key.csv")
```

```{r get dataset together}
day3 <- read.csv("/Users/AprilBooth/Desktop/Dissertation/Chapter2_cropmilk/R_markdowns/chick_size_d3.csv")
day3$weight_gm <- as.numeric(day3$weight_gm)
day3$size3 <- (day3$weight_gm/day3$tarsus)
key <- select(key, "nestid", "brood")
day3 <- left_join(day3, key, by = "nestid")
day3$treatment[day3$treatment == "paired"] <- "paired parents"
day3$treatment[day3$treatment == "single female"] <- "single mother"
day3$treatment[day3$treatment == "single male"] <- "single father"
day3$type[day3$treatment == "paired parents"] <- "paired parents"
day3$type[day3$treatment == "single mother"] <- "single parent"
day3$type[day3$treatment == "single father"] <- "single parent"
day3$chick_s[day3$chick == "a"] <- "first hatched"
day3$chick_s[day3$chick == "b"] <- "second hatched"
day3 <- select(day3, "nestid", "treatment", "chick", "size3", "brood", "type", "chick_s")
day3 <- na.omit(day3)
```


```{r get average for two chick nests}
one <- day3[day3$brood == "one",]
# will remove second hatched chick that died
one <- one[-c(10), ]
two <- day3[day3$brood == "two",]
twoa <- two[two$chick == "a",]
twob <- two[two$chick == "b",]
two <- full_join(twoa, twob, by = "nestid")
two$size3 <- (two$size3.x + two$size3.y)/2
two$brood <- two$brood.x
two$treatment <- two$treatment.x
two$type[two$treatment == "paired parents"] <- "paired parents"
two$type[two$treatment == "single mother"] <- "single parent"
two$type[two$treatment == "single father"] <- "single parent"
two <- select(two, "nestid", "brood", "size3", "treatment", "type")
```
# counting two-chick and one-chick broods
```{r}
twoa %>% count(treatment)
```
```{r}
one %>% count(treatment)
```

```{r one and two data sets}
data_size3 <- full_join(one, two)
data_size3 <- select(data_size3, "nestid", "brood", "size3", "treatment", "type")
```

##Graphing data to see how it looks:
```{r}
chick_size <- ggplot(aes(y = size3, x = treatment, fill=treatment), data = data_size3) + geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA) + scale_fill_manual(values = colors_chick) +
  labs(title = "Average chick size (weight/tarsus ratio)",subtitle = "", x="", y="weight/tarsus day 3 post-hatch") + geom_point(pch = 21, position = position_jitterdodge()) + theme_B3() + scale_x_discrete(limits=c("paired parents", "single mother", "single father")) + theme(text=element_text(family="Arial", size=14)) +theme(axis.text = element_text(face = "bold", color = "black",family="Arial", size = 14)) + theme(legend.position = "none") + ggsignif::geom_signif(comparisons = list(c("single father","paired parents")), map_signif_level = TRUE , y_position = c(5), textsize = 9) + ylim(1,5.6)
chick_size
```
#now do ANOVA analysis
```{r}
leveneTest(size3 ~ treatment, data = data_size3, center = mean)
```
```{r}
leveneTest(size3 ~ brood, data = data_size3, center = mean)
```
# so parametric ok
```{r}
fit_c <- aov(size3 ~ treatment+brood , data = data_size3)
Anova(fit_c, type = "II")
```

```{r}
eta_squared(Anova(fit_c, type = "II"))
```
```{r}
TukeyHSD(fit_c)
```
# so significant difference single fathered chicks versus paired parented nests.
# effect size for comparisons
# make subsets of data
```{r}
paired <- data_size3[data_size3$treatment == "paired parents",]
s_mom <- data_size3[data_size3$treatment == "single mother",]
s_fath <- data_size3[data_size3$treatment == "single father",]
```

# paired parented v single fathered
```{r}
p_vs_sfath <- full_join(paired, s_fath)
cohens_d(size3 ~ treatment, data = p_vs_sfath)
```


# what about by nest type?
```{r}
leveneTest(size3 ~ type, data = data_size3, center = mean)
```
# so parametric ok
```{r}
fit_cs <- aov(size3 ~ type+brood , data = data_size3)
Anova(fit_cs, type = "II")
```

```{r}
eta_squared(Anova(fit_cs, type = "II"))
```
# so single parented chicks are smaller than paired parented chicks in general as well. 

# asychronous nests
#confirm if first and second hatched chicks are significantly different
```{r}
asynch_a <- ggplot(aes(y = size3, x = treatment, fill=treatment), data = twoa) + geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA) +
  labs(title = "Chick size of first-hatched chicks (two-chick nests)", x="", y="weight/tarsus day 3 post-hatch") + scale_fill_manual(values = colors_chick) + theme_B3() + theme(text=element_text(family="Arial", size=14)) +theme(axis.text = element_text(face = "bold", color = "black",family="Arial", size = 14)) +  geom_point(pch = 21, position = position_jitterdodge()) + theme(legend.position = "none") + scale_x_discrete(limits=c("paired parents", "single mother", "single father")) + ylim(1,5.5)
asynch_a
```
```{r}
leveneTest(size3 ~ treatment, data = twoa, center = mean)
```

```{r}
fit_a <- aov(size3 ~ treatment, data = twoa)
Anova(fit_a)
```
```{r}
eta_squared(fit_a)
```
# so no significant difference between treatment groups in terms of first hatched chicks of two chick nests. 
# nest type?
```{r}
leveneTest(size3 ~ type, data = twoa, center = mean)
```
```{r}
t.test(size3 ~ type, data = twoa, var.equal = TRUE)
```
# cohen's d
```{r}
cohens_d(size3 ~ type, data = twoa)
```

```{r}
asynch_b <- ggplot(aes(y = size3, x = treatment, fill=treatment), data = twob) + geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA) +
  labs(title = "Chick size of second-hatched chicks (two-chick nests)",subtitle = "", x="", y="weight/tarsus day 3 post-hatch") + scale_fill_manual(values = colors_chick) + theme_B3() + theme(text=element_text(family="Arial", size=14)) +theme(axis.text = element_text(face = "bold", color = "black",family="Arial", size = 14)) +  geom_point(pch = 21, position = position_jitterdodge()) + theme(legend.position = "none") + ggsignif::geom_signif(comparisons = list(c("paired parents", "single father")), map_signif_level = TRUE, y_position = c(4.25), textsize = 9) + ggsignif::geom_signif(comparisons = list(c("paired parents", "single mother")), map_signif_level = TRUE, y_position = c(4.8), textsize = 9) + scale_x_discrete(limits=c("paired parents", "single mother", "single father")) + ylim(1,5.5)
asynch_b
```
```{r}
leveneTest(size3 ~ treatment, data = twob, center = mean)
```
#so parametric fine. 
```{r}
fit_b <- aov(size3 ~ treatment, data = twob)
Anova(fit_b, type= "III")
```

```{r}
eta_squared(fit_b)
```
```{r}
TukeyHSD(fit_b)
```

# cohen's d
```{r}
paired <- twob[twob$treatment == "paired parents",]
smom <- twob[twob$treatment == "single mother",]
sfath <- twob[twob$treatment == "single father",]
```
# paired parents vs single mothers
```{r}
paired_vs_smom <- full_join(paired, smom)
cohens_d(size3 ~ treatment, data = paired_vs_smom)
```

# paired parents vs single fathers
```{r}
paired_vs_sfath <- full_join(paired, sfath)
cohens_d(size3 ~ treatment, data = paired_vs_sfath)
```
# nest type?
```{r}
leveneTest(size3 ~ type, data = twob, center = mean)
```
```{r}
t.test(size3 ~ type, data = twob, var.equal = TRUE)
```
# cohen's d
```{r}
cohens_d(size3 ~ type, data = twob)
```
